title: Çorba

characters.HUSBAND: a man of about thirty-five with short dark hair and stubble, wearing a grey knitted sweater
characters.WIFE: a woman of about thirty-three with wavy auburn hair, wearing a mint green cardigan

scenes.text:
Eşinin seni en çok sevdiği an,
sandığın gibi yıldönümü değil.
scenes.prompt: A table set for a fancy dinner with candles and a vase of red roses in an empty room at night, rain on the window behind it. No people.

scenes.text:
Sen ateşler içinde yatarken
gece yarısı mutfakta yanan ışık.
scenes.prompt: At midnight in a small kitchen with one warm light on, {HUSBAND} stands at the stove stirring a pot, steam rising, rain on the dark window.

scenes.text:
Uykusuzdu, yorgundu;
tarif bilmeden çorba yaptı.
scenes.prompt: In the same kitchen at night, {HUSBAND} looks at the steaming pot on the stove with a tired, unsure expression, messy counter, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Tuzu fazlaydı.
Yine de hayatının en güzel çorbasıydı.
scenes.prompt: In a bedroom lit by a bedside lamp, {WIFE} sits up in bed under a thick quilt smiling weakly, a bowl of soup on the bedside table, {HUSBAND} sits on the edge of the bed on the right smiling at her.

scenes.text:
Aşk çiçekte değil, o tencerede saklı.
Bunu eşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn evening in the warm kitchen, {WIFE} stands at the stove smiling, while {HUSBAND} sits at the kitchen table on the left wrapped in a blanket, rain on the window.

caption:
Çorbayı kim yaptı?

Aşk bazen tuzu fazla bir çorbadır. 🤍

Bunu eşine gönder.
